results.name: All thirteen decorated routes retain their actual source/action targets and registered commands
Work filters retain owner, query and kind while the selected queue is announced
Primary queue tables have exact heading references without changing their rows
An empty personal queue cannot label a subsequent owned-program table
Notification accessibility names remain unique and escape source content
Reading and acknowledging a notification never presents its open source as resolved
The notification next action still opens the exact task and rejects a different recipient
Presentation does not change effective access, saved policies or current source records
Repeated module loading is inert and never creates a second main landmark
